# R2.11 — Approval UX + monitor-acceptance residual: the `modify` terminal, `label.endorsed{basis: approval}` over a durable intent anchor, `check_write` at `prepare`, and the remedy-ingress seam

Ticket `docs/tickets/117_R2.11__approvals-monitor-acceptance.md`
(seq 117). Stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.10` (PR #117);
ADR-0343. Offline-only: every cell is `fixture`-verified — no
live/staging environment, no production mutation; the remedy *consume*
path stays R2.12's by contract.

**Requirement ids:** DF-S1.23-1 · DF-S1.11-2 · BL-22 · BL-23 ·
R-2.8.1 · R-2.8.5 · R-2.8.7.

## What landed

**The C2 `modify` arm — a terminal decision, never an in-place edit
(ADR-0343 D1).** `ApprovalOptionId::Modify` joins the closed option
set; `ResponseChoice::Modify{amended_args}` /
`PermissionOutcome::Modified{amended_args}` carry the typed amendment.
`respond_inner` records `Decision::Modified` on the owed
`security.permission.decided{decision: modified, amended_args}` row —
the as-proposed effect refuses `action.effect.refused{reason:
modified}` + `action.tool.rejected`; the amendment re-enters as a
fresh request that re-runs `authorize` (narrowing-only by
construction — the decision confers nothing). `modify` answers the
same gates `allow*` answers: the principal/`ApproverGrant` legitimacy
gate (a delegate-voiced modify would burn the exactly-one decision)
and `OptionNotOffered` read off the *durable* `request.options` — a
folded pending applies the recorded offer, never the surface's say-so.
A recorded `modified` serves idempotently through the monitor fold.

**`label.endorsed{basis: approval}` mints at the produce-time call
site (ADR-0343 D2).** The egress ask path appends
`action.intent.anchored{permission_id, effect_id, subject_ref,
capability_ref, args_canonical_hash}` — stamped with the
*participant's* provenance at `ContentKind::EffectIntent` — durable
*before* `pending`, so the endorsement's subject exists in the
committed prefix. One shared `approval_endorsement` helper (used by
`respond_permission` and `surface_respond_permission` — CC1) resolves
the anchor, raises its label to the responder's authority via
`hh_provenance::endorse`, and appends
`security.label.endorsed{basis: approval, basis_ref: permission_id}`
in the `granted` batch. `NoLabelIncrease` mints nothing; other
illegitimate endorsements refuse typed; no anchor ⇒ no endorsement —
never fabricated.

**`check_write` at `prepare` over the C3 machinery (ADR-0343 D3).**
`OwnedObject{FsPathPrefix|ResourceKey}` / `OwnershipTable` /
`WriteVerdict` / `check_write` moved home to `hh-monitor` (deps point
downward; `hh-subagent` re-exports — one home, CC1). The dispatcher's
`set_ownership_roots` arms the regime: at `prepare`, the effect's
write objects — the canonical `path` of an `fs_write` plus every
`Resources::Declared` key — run `check_write` over a projection of the
armed roots + every `control.ownership.*` row across the run tree (a
child sees the parent's grants — the depth-3 chain cell). A denial
mints `security.policy.evaluated{check: ownership, verdict: deny}` +
`refused` + `tool.rejected` and returns `Refused`; unarmed ⇒ the
regime is not in play and the check honestly does not run.

**The remedy-ingress seam R2.12 consumes (ADR-0343 D4).**
`ApprovalRequest.remedies` carries the ask's offered `Remedy` set;
`pending_payload` serializes it under the declared `request` member;
the fold restores it; the respond paths echo it verbatim onto
`security.permission.decided.remedies`. R2.12's consume path
(`remedies.taken`, remedy re-dispatch, `shape_endorsed` stamping)
reads this durable record — R2.11 lands the ingress and deliberately
not the consume leg.

**Supporting schema/ledger changes.** `hh-ledger` registers
`action.intent.anchored` (durable, provenance-required,
non-audit-grade — the participant provenance stays below kernel
authority; hosted lowering `hint`) and admits bounded `amended_args`
on the audit-grade `decided` partition. `hh-embed-schema` gains
`PermissionOutcome.Modified` — generated artifacts regenerated (CC7).

**DF/BL dispositions.** DF-S1.23-1 → DONE (the row's three remaining
members all landed). DF-S1.11-2 → DONE (check 8 + the depth-3 cell
were its last open members). BL-22/BL-23 → closed. COVERAGE
R-2.8.7 → MET; R-2.8.1/R-2.3.3 notes refreshed. DF-S2.7-1 verified
untouched — the consume path is R2.12's.

## Tests (fail-if-removed)

- `crates/hh-env/tests/r2_11.rs` — 8 cells: the intent anchor durable
  beside `pending`; recorded `modified` refuses the as-proposed
  effect; `check_write` `NotOwner`/`Fenced`/`ResourceKey` refusals at
  `prepare`; own-root admit; the depth-3 ownership/delegation chain;
  the pure `check_write` agreeing with the prepare gate.
- `crates/hh-embed/tests/r2_11.rs` — 5 cells:
  `label.endorsed{basis: approval}` over the anchor (`from` =
  intent's delegate label, `to` = responder's principal, `basis_ref` =
  permission_id); `decided{modified, amended_args}` + idempotent
  replay + `AlreadyDecided`; `OptionNotOffered` on unoffered `modify`
  *and* unoffered `selected`; the pending→decided remedies echo; no
  anchor ⇒ no endorsement.
